summary: National Rural Utilities Cooperative Finance Corporation filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for an at-the-market program of unsecured, subordinated deferrable interest notes. Notes mature no earlier than 30 years from issuance; a separate pricing supplement sets price, rate and maturity. CFC may defer interest up to 20 semi-annual or 40 quarterly periods, with compounding. Notes are subordinated to senior debt, senior to members' subordinated certificates, pari passu with existing subordinated notes, uninsured, unlisted, and sold in $1,000 minimums through InspereX, Citigroup, RBC, Wells Fargo. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation.
